title: Find a percent of a number (25% of 80)

lesson.title: Finding 25 Percent of 80

steps.say: You already know that 25 percent is the same as one quarter, and the same as zero point two five. Today we use that to answer a question like this one: what is 25 percent of 80?

visual.caption: 25 percent means 25 out of every 100 squares

steps.say: Here is the big idea. The word of means take that much of the whole thing. So 25 percent of 80 means: cut 80 into four equal parts, because 25 percent is one quarter, and then take one of those parts.

visual.caption: A bar worth 80, cut into four equal parts of 20

steps.say: Look at the bar. Eighty split into four equal parts gives 20 in each part. One of those parts is 20, so 25 percent of 80 is 20. In symbols we can write zero point two five times 80, which is also 20. Both roads land on the same place.

visual.caption: The 20 piece and the 60 that is left

steps.say: Now here is a trap I want you to watch for. Some kids see 15 percent of 40 and just answer 15. But 15 percent is not a plain number, it is an instruction that says take 15 out of every 100. Since 40 is smaller than 100, the answer has to be smaller than 15. The real answer is 6, because zero point one five times 40 is 6. A percent is always a piece of something, never the whole answer on its own.

visual.caption: 15 percent of 40 is a small slice, not 15

steps.say: So remember: percent of a number means turn the percent into a fraction or a decimal, then multiply. Twenty-five percent of 80 is 20.

lesson.answer: Percent of a number means multiply: 25 percent of 80 is one quarter of 80, which is 20.

practice.question: Nina earns 60 dollars from her paper route in Kelowna, and she wants to put 25 percent of it into her camping fund. Draw a bar worth 60 dollars and cut it into four equal parts, because 25 percent is one quarter. How many dollars go into the camping fund?
practice.answer: 15 dollars. Sixty dollars split into four equal parts gives 15 dollars in each part, and 25 percent is one of those parts. Checking with decimals: zero point two five times 60 equals 15.
